mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation (Business License for Enterprise Legal Person)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and the local municipal or district Market Regulation Administration where the WFOE is registered.
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarize the original Business License at a PRC notary public; for an Apostille Convention destination, obtain a single Hague Apostille from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China or an authorized provincial foreign affairs office. For a non-member destination, obtain PRC MFA legalization followed by consular legalization from the destination state's embassy or consulate. The two paths are parallel and mutually exclusive; never chain an apostille with consular legalization.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing (Enterprise Credit Information Extract)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: State Administration for Market Regulation through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System.
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Obtain a certified or notarized extract with a valid verification QR code; then apply either for a Hague Apostille through the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China or, for non-member states, for PRC MFA legalization followed by destination-state consular legalization. Apostille and consular legalization are mutually exclusive parallel routes and must never be combined sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution and Power of Attorney authorizing formation, bank account opening, and vessel charter negotiations
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors or sole shareholder of CN_WFOE_LTD, sitting in a properly convened meeting and notarized by a PRC notary public.
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: The notarized resolution or power of attorney must be authenticated by a single Hague Apostille for Apostille Convention states, or, for non-member states, by PRC MFA legalization followed by consular legalization at the destination state's consulate or embassy. These paths are parallel and mutually exclusive; sequential chaining is prohibited.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association (with all shareholding and UBO schedules)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Sole shareholder or shareholders' meeting of CN_WFOE_LTD, notarized by a PRC notary public.
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarize the Articles of Association and all UBO exhibits; then obtain a Hague Apostille from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China for Apostille Convention states, or PRC MFA legalization plus destination-state consular legalization for non-member states. The apostille route and the consular legalization route are mutually exclusive and never applied one after the other.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: A licensed commercial bank in the People's Republic of China, bearing the bank's compliance officer signature and corporate seal; if the Taiwan branch is used, a Taiwanese licensed bank may countersign.
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: The bank reference letter must be notarized by a PRC notary public and then taken through either a Hague Apostille (Apostille Convention destination) or PRC MFA legalization plus consular legalization (non-member destination). The two authentication mechanisms are separate and mutually exclusive; no sequential combination is permitted.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO Declaration and Ownership Structure Chart
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Each ultimate beneficial owner owning 25% or more of CN_WFOE_LTD, notarized by a PRC notary public.
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarize the UBO declaration and then obtain a single Hague Apostille for Apostille Convention states, or PRC MFA legalization followed by consular legalization for non-member states. Apostille and consular legalization are parallel and mutually exclusive and must never be chained.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All shareholders, directors, ultimate beneficial owners, authorized signatories, and commercial counterparties of CN_WFOE_LTD must be screened prior to formation, at bank account opening, and on a continuous risk-based basis against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, PRC PBOC/SAFE sanctioned entity lists, and Taiwan Financial Supervisory Commission AML/CFT blacklists. Politically exposed persons require enhanced due diligence, source-of-wealth/source-of-funds verification, senior management approval, and heightened ongoing monitoring. Negative news and adverse media screening is mandatory; all results must be documented and retained for at least five years after business termination.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: State Administration for Market Regulation - National Integrated Enterprise Registration and Name Declaration Online Service Platform; for a Taiwan branch entity, Ministry of Economic Affairs Company and Business Registration Name Approval System.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: A PRC WFOE company name must be written in simplified Chinese characters and must follow the four-tier statutory naming convention: administrative division, distinctive name, industry or operation characteristic, and organizational form. Foreign investor names must be transliterated using standard Mandarin Pinyin unless a legally registered foreign-language trademark exists. The English trade name may be used as a supplementary identification but does not replace the registered Chinese legal name. For a Taiwan branch, the branch name must contain the parent company name and a Taiwan branch identifier, and transliteration must follow Taiwan Ministry of Economic Affairs registration requirements.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, obtain the written rejection decision. The applicant must remove or replace the offending name components and re-file the name declaration with corrected documentation. If the applicant believes the rejection is legally erroneous, it may file an administrative reconsideration with the local market regulation administrative department or superior SAMR within 60 calendar days of service, or initiate an administrative lawsuit with the competent People's Court within six months. The appeal packet must include the original rejection notice, corrected name declaration, the WFOE's legal verification memo, and proof of the authorized filer's identity and authority. For a Taiwan branch name clearance, the same rights of appeal are exercised before the Ministry of Economic Affairs.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Rejected. For a WFOE engaged in ISIC 5222 offshore supply vessel leasing, municipal tax authorities, maritime safety authorities, and banks will reject a virtual office or commercial mailbox because charter party administration, vessel flag and insurance documentation, crew records, and statutory books must be maintained at a physical operational office. Under PRC Foreign Investment Law and Taiwan maritime and shipping authority practice, a registered office must be a real address where legal process can be served and where directors, executives, or a lawful statutory representative can receive notices. Use of a virtual office in this Medium_Risk_Enhanced industry will trigger tax registration denial, bank account refusal, and commercial substance deficiency findings.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Checklist for unannounced physical inspection by municipal tax or registry authority: (1) physical office signboard and lease agreement; (2) on-site employees and payroll records; (3) statutory books, seals, and board minutes; (4) original Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing; (5) vessel charter agreements, flag certificates, and P&I insurance; (6) invoicing, accounting, and tax return records; (7) bank statements and treasury records. Quantified risk: 72% to 84% probability of an unannounced on-site inspection within the first 12 months of registration given the Medium_Risk_Enhanced offshore marine charter classification and the mandatory statutory license requirement.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Act of Taiwan (Republic of China), as amended, Articles 1, 2, 17, 18, 100, 128, 153-157, 172, 192, 203 and 208; Foreign Investment Act; Regulations on Company Name and Business Scope Pre-Approval; and Mainland-Area Investment Regulations where the ultimate investor is a mainland China entity
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Department of Commercial Services, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Taiwan, acting through the One-Stop Company and Commercial Registration Portal
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Company Registration Application Form and Articles of Incorporation filed under the Company Act
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital applies under the Company Act; however, the subscribed capital in the Articles of Incorporation must be fully paid in cash into a designated Taiwan bank account established in the name of the company preparatory office. For a foreign investment WFOE, the amount approved by the Investment Commission must be remitted from abroad and the paid-in capital must be evidenced by a certified public accountant capital verification report. No blocked escrow account is required by general incorporation law, but funds supporting the registration must remain deposited in the Taiwan bank account until the registration certificate is issued.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: AT THE FIRST MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF CN_WFOE_LTD, a company proposed to be incorporated under the laws and regulations of Taiwan, held on the date set forth below and noticed to all directors, it is unanimously resolved that: (1) The Company shall be incorporated as a limited liability company, being a wholly foreign-owned enterprise, under the Company Act of Taiwan and the Foreign Investment Act. The draft Articles of Incorporation submitted and read to the Board are approved and adopted. The authorised share capital of the Company shall be as set forth in the Articles of Incorporation, divided into ordinary shares of no par value, and all such share capital is hereby subscribed for by the shareholders identified in the Articles. Each subscriber shall pay the amount opposite its name in cash to the designated bank account of the company preparation office before the statutory filing; receipt of deposit and the certified public accountant capital verification report shall constitute conclusive evidence of subscription and payment. (2) The Board authorises the Chairman, the General Manager, and the Finance Manager, acting jointly by any two of them, to open, maintain, close and otherwise operate corporate demand and deposit accounts in Taiwan and abroad, with banks designated from time to time; to execute account opening applications, signature cards, wire transfer instructions, loan documents, and all related instruments; and to act as corporate authorised signatories. (3) The registered office of the Company is fixed at the street address set out in the Articles of Incorporation, Taiwan, and the Board authorises the Chairman to execute and file all address registration notifications, lease consents, and ownership documentation required by the Ministry of Economic Affairs and the land registry. (4) The Board appoints the nominee identified in the notice as Chairman of the Board, the nominee identified in the notice as General Manager and principal statutory manager, the nominee identified in the notice as Accounting Officer, and the nominee identified in the notice as Compliance Officer for maritime licensing and anti-money-laundering obligations. Each officer shall have authority within the ordinary course of business, subject to law and board policy. The Chairman is further authorised to file the Company Registration Application with the competent authority and to make any amendments required by that authority, provided that such amendments are not inconsistent with the fundamental terms of the Articles. This resolution is effective immediately and shall remain in full force until revoked or superseded. So resolved.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Foreign Investment Approval, Name Reservation, and Pre-Contract Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), acting through the One-Stop Company and Commercial Registration Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit online through the One-Stop Portal the statutory Foreign Investment Application and pre-reservation application for the company name, together with the proposed English and Chinese trade names (if any). The Controller will screen the ultimate mainland investor under the applicable cross-strait regulations and review the business scope of offshore supply vessel leasing for compatibility with ISIC 5222. The applicant must disclose all proposed shareholders, funding sources, bank routes, and the draft chartering plan. After the Investment Commission issues its approval letter, the same portal shall issue a name reservation certificate valid for six months. The filing is deemed complete only when supporting documents have been notarized and apostilled (if issued abroad) and submitted in the required electronic format. The dossier must include the executed power of attorney, board resolution of the investing company, audited financial statements, identity documents, and proof of the proposed physical registered office.
required_dossiers: Completed Foreign Investment Application Form
Name reservation application and proposed Article draft
Certificate of incorporation and articles of incorporation of the ultimate investor
Audited financial statements of the investing company for the last fiscal year
Executed power of attorney in favor of the local formation agent
Passport or national ID of proposed directors and shareholders
Notarized and apostilled copies of all foreign-origin documents
Investment plan and offshore supply vessel chartering business plan
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried or suspended, the applicant has 30 calendar days from the date of notice to respond to the Investment Commission with corrected or supplementary evidence; a request for an extension may be filed before the deadline. If the application is refused, the applicant may resubmit with an amended business scope or shareholder structure, or file a written administrative appeal to the Executive Yuan within 30 days after service of the refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Approve Articles, Open Pre-Formation Bank Account, and Verify Capital Contributions
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Taiwan Banking Act-licensed banking institution and an independent certified public accountant (CPA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The promoters or authorized officers open a pre-formation bank account in the approved company name. The foreign investor remits the subscribed paid-up capital from an overseas bank through SWIFT wire using the description paid-in capital; the deposit receipt is stamped by the bank. The subscribers execute the Articles of Incorporation and the minutes or written consent of the first shareholders meeting. The CPA verifies that contributions have been received in cash and issues a capital verification report setting out the aggregate paid-in capital, share allotment, and bank deposit account number. This report is an attachment to the company registration application. In the event no minimum capital is required by law, the amount stated in the articles is nevertheless subject to the Investment Commission approved foreign investment amount; any increase requires a new approval. The bank must apply customer due diligence and beneficial-owner checks consistent with Taiwan Anti-Money Laundering requirements.
required_dossiers: Approved name reservation letter
Articles of Incorporation signed by all subscribers
Minutes or written consent of the first shareholders meeting
Bank deposit slips and SWIFT wire remittance records
Company preparatory office bank account certificate
CPA capital verification report
Beneficial ownership and source-of-funds declarations for the bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects the account opening request or the CPA identifies deficiencies in the capital verification, the applicant should correct the source-of-funds documentation, provide updated beneficial-owner statements, or select another licensed bank. Any shortfall in the remitted amount must be cured by a supplemental wire prior to registration; the statutory filing deadline may be extended by re-dating the capital verification, provided the remittance is completed before the MOEA application is submitted.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File Company Incorporation and Tax and Labor Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Commercial Services, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) through the One-Stop Portal; National Taxation Bureau under the Ministry of Finance
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the consolidated application on the One-Stop Portal: company registration application, articles, capital verification, signed minutes, appointment letters, name reservation certificate, foreign investment approval letter, lease or ownership proof, corporate officer identity documents, and filing fee payment. MOEA registers the limited liability company and issues a company registration certificate and a unified number. The One-Stop Portal concurrently notifies the National Taxation Bureau for business registration, uniform invoice entitlement, and withholding tax registration. The registering officer must then complete labor insurance, health insurance, and labor pension establishment at the Bureau of Labor Insurance before engaging employees, and should retain an employment statement and tax withholding declaration records at the registered office.
required_dossiers: Company Registration Application Form
Articles of Incorporation and signed board or shareholder minutes
CPA capital verification report
Foreign Investment Commission approval letter
Name reservation certificate
Appointment letters for statutory officers
Lease agreement or ownership certificate for the registered office
Identity documents of directors and shareholders
Filing fee payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If MOEA issues a defect notice or suspension, the applicant shall cure the stated defects within 15 business days and resubmit through the One-Stop Portal. If the rejection is contested, the applicant may file an administrative appeal with the Ministry of Economic Affairs within 30 days after notification, or restart the application after amending the articles and recalculating the paid-in capital if required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Secure Offshore Supply Vessel Leasing Permit and Civil Defense and Environmental Compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Maritime Port Bureau, Ministry of Transportation and Communications (MOTC); Local Fire Department Civil Defense Division; Environmental Protection Administration and Marine Conservation Administration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After MOEA registration, file the shipping enterprise vessel chartering application with the Maritime Port Bureau using the company registration certificate and unified number. The application must identify each offshore supply vessel by IMO number, flag, class certificate, tonnage, and proposed lease or charter operations in Taiwan waters, and include a twenty-four-hour emergency response point, pollution liability insurance certificate, and charter contract template. The Bureau will inspect the shore office and vessel records and issue the relevant operator registration; where the vessel is chartered with crew, crew documentation must be submitted. For the physical office and any dock-side stowage of fuel or oily stores, obtain a fire safety report from the local fire department and a port facility security clearance. File a marine pollution prevention plan with the Environmental Protection Administration or Marine Conservation Administration if bunkering, waste-oil transfer, or oily wash-water discharge will occur. Discharge and emissions compliance must meet MARPOL Annex I thresholds, with total oil concentration in oily water less than 15 parts per million, zero discharges in coastal protection zones, and approved waste-oil reception receipts for every vessel call.
required_dossiers: MOEA company registration certificate and unified number
Shipping enterprise chartering application form
List of offshore supply vessels with IMO numbers and class certificates
Charter or lease contract templates
Pollution liability insurance certificate
Fire safety inspection report and civil defense clearance application
Port facility security clearance for shore office or dock access
Marine pollution prevention plan if fuel handling or discharge is envisaged
Employment and crew documentation if the vessel is operated with crew
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Maritime Port Bureau issues a conditional approval, suspension, or deficiency letter, the applicant must respond in writing within 21 calendar days with additional vessel classification, insurance, or operational evidence and may request a technical review. An adverse final decision may be appealed to the Ministry of Transportation and Communications and thereafter to the administrative court; the company may also revise the charter business plan and resubmit the application.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Maritime Port Bureau, Ministry of Transportation and Communications (MOTC), Taiwan
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Shipping Enterprise Charterer Permit and Offshore Supply Vessel Operator Registration under the Shipping Enterprise Act of Taiwan

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Administration (EPA), Executive Yuan; Marine Conservation Administration, Ocean Affairs Council
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Statutory EIA not required for pure vessel-leasing chartering because no land development is undertaken; if the applicant constructs shore support facilities, berths, or fuel storage, the competent authority will classify the project under the Environmental Impact Assessment Act and require a project environmental impact assessment statement before construction approval.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: MARPOL 73/78 Annex I compliance: oily water discharge concentration must not exceed 15 parts per million; no oil or oily mixture may be discharged within 12 nautical miles of the Taiwan coast; all waste oil and oily residues must be delivered to certified port reception facilities with signed receipts retained onboard and at the shore office; any hazardous waste transfer must be manifested under the Taiwan Waste Disposal Act.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety inspection certificate and civil defense clearance for the shore office, stores area, and any dock-side support premises; annual fire safety equipment inspection report; structural and electrical load certificate for any marine stores shed or fuel storage area; Occupational Safety and Health Act compliance inspection for maintenance and cargo-handling areas; and port facility security clearance issued for the vessel and shore interface.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Finance, Taiwan - National Taxation Bureau (regional competent tax office) and the Tax Entry Portal at https://etax.nat.gov.tw; e-invoice data is handled through the Ministry of Finance Integrated E-Invoice Platform at https://www.einvoice.nat.gov.tw.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign non-resident entity intending to conduct taxable business in Taiwan through a fixed place of business, branch, or permanent establishment must first complete foreign-company commercial registration/approval with the Ministry of Economic Affairs. The entity must then apply to the competent National Taxation Bureau for tax registration before business commencement or within 15 days of approval/commencement, submitting the foreign-company registration certificate, approved branch/charter documents, authorized tax agent, registered address proof, and business scope. Upon approval, the Bureau issues an 8-digit Unified Business Number (UBIN), which serves as the VAT registration number and withholding tax account identification. A foreign enterprise without a fixed place of business in Taiwan but deriving Taiwan-source income is not normally VAT-registered; the Taiwan payor performs Income Tax Act withholding and the foreign entity may appoint a tax agent for filings. Online registration and post-registration filing are available through the Tax Entry Portal after credential issuance.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. Taiwan does not provide check-the-box or hybrid mismatch entity classification elections; tax character is determined under the Income Tax Act and the Value-added and Non-value-added Business Tax Act.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT - Taiwan Value-added and Non-value-added Business Tax (Business Tax)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general turnover threshold for mandatory standard VAT registration; any enterprise with a fixed place of business or permanent establishment must register before starting business. Domestic small-scale vendors with monthly average sales below NT$80,000 may qualify for a small-scale exemption from Uniform Invoice and standard VAT requirements, but offshore vessel-leasing and cross-border marine chartering operations are not eligible for that small-scale concession.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Taiwan mandates the Uniform Invoice system for VAT-registered businesses. Taxpayers must issue Uniform Invoices for taxable sales, and electronic invoices must be transmitted to the Ministry of Finance Integrated E-Invoice Platform through the E-Invoice Turnkey Service with prescribed upload deadlines and cross-track reconciliation. Designated/e-invoice users must use government-specified electronic transmission formats and API mechanisms, include serial-number and QR/error-control markings, and comply with anti-fraud controls covering invoice uniqueness, void/recording, and taxpayer account authentication. Zero-rated export and offshore supply sales are evidenced by zero-rated Uniform Invoices supported by customs and foreign-exchange documentation.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods physically exported from Taiwan, goods supplied to foreign vessels engaged in international transportation, and services supplied to foreign enterprises or overseas consumers that are not used within Taiwan and are paid in foreign exchange qualify for zero-rating. The offshore supply vessel leasing and chartering business qualifies where the offshore platform support vessel is chartered for international or Taiwan-external offshore operations and charter hire is paid in foreign currency by a foreign charterer, with the service not consumed or beneficially enjoyed within Taiwan. Zero-rating preserves the exporter's entitlement to input VAT credit or refund.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration issued by Taiwan Customs (customs export report with export validation)
Ocean Bill of Lading or vessel charter-party/sea waybill evidencing the offshore supply or international voyage
Foreign Exchange Settlement Slip or Export Proceeds Remittance Certificate issued by an authorized bank evidencing repatriation of foreign-currency charter hire
Commercial invoice and charter agreement in foreign currency evidencing the cross-border maritime supply
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Zero-rating claims are subject to strict documentary audit by the National Taxation Bureau. If the customs export declaration, bill of lading, foreign-exchange settlement evidence, or charter documentation is missing, inconsistent, or not repatriated within the applicable deadline, the zero-rate is disallowed, the supply is recharacterized as taxable at 5%, additional business tax is assessed, and late-payment interest and statutory penalties apply, including clawback of any previously refunded input VAT. Fraudulent, fictitious, or forged export/charter documentation invokes enhanced assessments, criminal liability under the Tax Collection Act, and heavier statutory penalties on the underpaid tax with possible extension of the retrospective assessment window.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Profit-Seeking Enterprise Income Tax Return and Attached Financial Statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau, Ministry of Finance, Taiwan (ROC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: May 1 to May 31 following the fiscal year-end for calendar-year filers; within 5 months of fiscal year-end for approved non-calendar fiscal years
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing surcharge of 3% of unpaid tax for each 30-day period, capped at 30%; daily arrears interest; understatement penalty of up to 3 times the evaded tax; coercive collection, asset seizure, and cancellation of tax registration for persistent non-compliance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Shareholders' Meeting, Approval of Financial Statements, and Filing of Meeting Minutes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Central Company Registration System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Meeting must be held within 6 months of fiscal year-end (by June 30 for calendar-year companies); minutes recorded and, where resolutions trigger registration, filed with MOEA within 15 days after the meeting
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine of NT$10,000 to NT$50,000 (approx. USD 310 to 1,550) imposed on responsible persons; shareholders may petition the court to convene the meeting; failure to commence or continue business for over 6 months may trigger MOEA-ordered dissolution under Company Act Article 10.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Company Responsible Persons and Major Shareholders (UBO) Information Filing and Annual Register Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), One-Stop Company and Business Registration Online Platform
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 15 days after any change in directors, supervisors, managers, or shareholders holding 10% or more; annual reconciliation to be completed before the June 30 shareholders' meeting
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine for failure to file or for false filing up to NT$500,000 (approx. USD 15,500); repeat violations escalate penalties and may lead to revocation of company registration; false UBO data also exposes the entity to anti-money-laundering and CDD sanctions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: CPA-Attested Annual Financial Statements (Statutory Audit) for Companies Meeting the Capital Threshold
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Approved CPA for attestation; audited statements submitted to shareholders, retained at registered office, and filed with the National Taxation Bureau as part of the annual income tax return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: CPA audit completed before the annual shareholders' meeting; financial statements approved by shareholders by June 30
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Responsible-person fines under the Business Entity Accounting Act for untrue or misleading statements; tax authority may reject unaudited statements and reassess income with penalties; regulatory review of the CPA's working papers may follow.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Shipping License Renewal and Offshore Supply Vessel Statutory Registration and Safety Inspection Endorsement
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Maritime Port Bureau (MTB), Ministry of Transportation and Communications (MOTC), Taiwan
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary of each vessel's registration and inspection certificate approval; shipping company license renewal as endorsed by MTB at 3 to 5-year intervals
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Operation of an unregistered or uninspected offshore supply vessel results in fines under the Ship Act and Shipping Act, vessel detention, voyage prohibition, suspension or revocation of the shipping license, and administrative deregistration of the vessel.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Value-Added Business Tax Return for the Final November to December Period of the Year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau, Ministry of Finance, Taiwan (ROC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due January 15 of the following year; recurring bi-monthly VAT returns are due by the 15th of each even-numbered month
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Surcharge for late filing up to NT$30,000 plus 15% of under-declared VAT; daily default interest; repeated non-filing may lead to suspension of the business tax registration and enforced collection.
